lessons.title: Purpose, Scope, and Repository Map
lessons.summary: CFE is a deliberately simplified conceptual hydrologic model designed to reproduce key National Water Model runoff behaviors behind a BMI interface.

content.text: CFE means Conceptual Functional Equivalent. The repository README describes it as a simplified conceptual model intended to be functionally equivalent to the National Water Model for important runoff-generation behavior. MODEL.md calls the scientific idea a t-shirt approximation: replace detail that behaves conceptually in practice with explicit conceptual stores and routing components. This is not a claim that CFE reproduces every NWM state or spatial process. It is a testable hypothesis that rainfall partitioning, vadose-zone storage, groundwater response, and routing can be represented more simply while retaining useful catchment response.

The implementation is primarily C. Public structures and function declarations live under include/, while src/cfe.c contains the timestep science and src/bmi_cfe.c adapts model state to the C Basic Model Interface. Separate src/conceptual_reservoir.c, src/giuh.c, and src/nash_cascade.c modules implement storage and routing behavior. The original_author_code directory preserves the earlier non-BMI program as historical evidence; it is not the implementation linked into the current BMI library.

A developer should distinguish hydrologic depth from discharge. Most core storages and timestep fluxes are represented as meters of water over a catchment. The model eventually combines surface runoff, delayed lateral runoff, and groundwater discharge into Qout_m. A framework can convert that catchment-depth result for downstream use. Keeping units visible is essential because configuration includes meters, meters per second, meters per hour, dimensionless ratios, and inverse-time coefficients.

The repository supports several execution arrangements. BASE reads local forcing without potential evapotranspiration. FORCING receives precipitation through BMI from AORC. FORCINGPET couples AORC and PET. AETROOTZONE also couples a soil-moisture-profile component. NGEN builds the shared BMI library for framework integration. When evaluating a defect, first identify the build mode, forcing source, runoff schemes, and optional couplings; otherwise the same source can follow materially different paths.

lessons.title: Timestep Data Flow and Water Accounting
lessons.summary: The cfe function advances one catchment timestep while explicitly tracking precipitation, evapotranspiration, storage transfers, routed runoff, and mass balance.

content.text: The central science entry point is cfe(...) in src/cfe.c. Its arguments expose the state-space boundary directly: soil and groundwater reservoir structures, rainfall depth, partitioning parameters, GIUH and Nash state arrays, evapotranspiration state, mass-balance accumulators, timestep duration, and output pointers. At entry it copies pointed-to values into local variables for readable domain calculations. The comments state that storages use meters and fluxes use meters per timestep.

A timestep first adds rainfall to volin and cumulative_vol. Potential evapotranspiration in meters per second is multiplied by time_step_size to obtain a timestep depth. Actual ET is then taken in an ordered sequence: from rainfall, from surface-retention storage when a surface Nash cascade exists, and from soil when storage exceeds wilting-point storage. Each removal updates dedicated ET totals, volout, and the reduced potential-ET budget so the same atmospheric demand is not spent repeatedly.

After ET changes soil storage, CFE recalculates the soil storage deficit. Positive rainfall is partitioned by the configured Schaake or Xinanjiang method into infiltration and infiltration excess. If proposed infiltration exceeds available soil capacity, the amount that cannot fit is returned to surface runoff. Infiltration enters the soil reservoir; conceptual_reservoir_flux_calc then computes primary percolation toward groundwater and secondary lateral flow toward the subsurface Nash cascade.

The outlet result is assembled from distinct travel paths. Surface excess is delayed by either GIUH convolution or a surface Nash cascade. Lateral soil flow is delayed by the subsurface Nash cascade. The groundwater reservoir contributes baseflow. Qout_m is their sum for the timestep. The massbal structure records cumulative inputs, outputs, internal transfers, ET, storage changes, and known leakage. Debugging should compare the component paths and storage deltas before blaming the final sum.

lessons.title: Rainfall Partitioning, Ice, and Evapotranspiration
lessons.summary: CFE can partition rainfall with Schaake or Xinanjiang logic and can remove atmospheric demand from rainfall, retention storage, and soil.

content.text: Surface-water partitioning decides how much rainfall becomes infiltration versus infiltration excess. With Schaake selected, Schaake_partitioning_scheme uses timestep length, field-capacity-related storage, a soil-adjusted magic constant, current deficit, soil capacity, depth, and optional ice information. Its behavior approaches complete runoff as available storage disappears. With Xinanjiang selected, Xinanjiang_partitioning_scheme uses maximum and current storage plus inflection, shape, and urban-fraction parameters to describe variable contributing areas.

Configuration must match the selected method. surface_water_partitioning_scheme accepts Schaake or Xinanjiang. Xinanjiang additionally requires a_Xinanjiang_inflection_point_parameter, b_Xinanjiang_shape_parameter, x_Xinanjiang_shape_parameter, and urban_decimal_fraction. Soil-freeze coupling supplies an ice fraction to either method. Schaake also requires ice_content_threshold when SFT coupling is enabled. When SFT is disabled, cfe explicitly resets the relevant ice fraction to zero before partitioning.

Evapotranspiration is constrained by both demand and available water. et_from_rainfall removes up to the timestep rainfall amount and reduces remaining potential ET. et_from_retention_depth can draw from the first surface Nash reservoir when storage is above zero. et_from_soil operates only when the soil reservoir exceeds wilting-point storage. The standard path uses a Budyko-style reduction; the optional root-zone path uses layer depths and a maximum root-zone layer supplied through coupling.

Ordering is part of the model contract. ET occurs before the soil deficit used for rainfall partitioning is recalculated. Moving ET after partitioning changes both infiltration capacity and runoff even when the ET total looks reasonable. A useful test therefore checks not only total Qout but also rainfall ET, soil ET, infiltration, excess, and the updated soil storage. This is also why a stale storage-deficit variable is a serious scientific bug rather than a cosmetic implementation detail.

lessons.title: Soil and Groundwater Reservoirs
lessons.summary: A shared conceptual-reservoir structure represents soil and groundwater stores with thresholded, potentially nonlinear outlets.

content.text: struct conceptual_reservoir stores current and maximum water depth, primary and secondary outlet coefficients, exponents, activation thresholds, and outlet counts. It also carries soil-layer and freeze-thaw fields used by optional couplings. The same general flux routine can represent different stores because behavior comes from configured outlet arrays rather than separate hard-coded equations for every reservoir.

conceptual_reservoir_flux_calc computes primary and secondary discharge from storage above each outlet threshold. A normalized storage ratio is raised to the configured exponent and multiplied by a coefficient. Flux is bounded by available water so the routine cannot withdraw more storage than exists. The soil reservoir has two important pathways: primary percolation to groundwater and secondary lateral flow. Groundwater contributes a primary baseflow path to the channel.

Several configuration values carry physical units that must not be mixed. soil_params.depth and reservoir storage depths are meters. soil_params.satdk is meters per second, while Cgw is documented in meters per hour. soil_params.slop scales the lower-boundary hydraulic gradient: one indicates free drainage and zero indicates no flow. gw_storage and soil_storage are initial fractions of their maximum stores rather than absolute meter depths.

Field-capacity and threshold calculations connect soil parameters to conceptual storage behavior. In root-zone mode, initialization verifies that the final soil_layer_depths value equals soil_params.depth, computes each layer thickness, and derives field-capacity water content from Clapp-Hornberger parameters. If depths are inconsistent, initialization returns BMI_FAILURE. Reservoir debugging should inspect maximum storage, current storage, thresholds, coefficients, exponents, and timestep units together; changing one value without its unit context can produce plausible but incorrect hydrographs.

lessons.title: GIUH and Nash Cascade Routing
lessons.summary: CFE delays surface and lateral runoff with explicit queues and reservoir cascades before combining them with groundwater discharge.

content.text: Partitioning determines water-path volume, while routing determines when that water reaches the outlet. The default surface_runoff_scheme is GIUH. giuh_ordinates is an array of dimensionless weights in timestep units. giuh_convolution_integral multiplies current runoff by each ordinate, adds those contributions to a runoff queue, returns the queue head as current direct runoff, then shifts the remaining queue toward the present.

A GIUH queue encodes a discrete travel-time distribution. Ordinates should collectively preserve the routed volume; malformed weights can create an apparent mass-balance problem even when partitioning is correct. The queue is persistent model state, so resetting it between updates removes delayed water. A sharp rainfall pulse should produce outlet response over multiple timesteps according to the ordinate pattern rather than disappearing after one call.

Nash routing represents delay with a series of conceptual linear reservoirs. nash_cascade_subsurface adds lateral flow to the first store, computes outflow from each store using K_nash, transfers that outflow into the next store, and returns discharge from the final store. The optional surface Nash path similarly routes infiltration excess, supports substeps, and can move a Kinf-controlled fraction back toward soil while retaining water below a configured depth in its first reservoir.

CFE always uses a subsurface Nash cascade for lateral soil flow, while surface runoff can select GIUH or NASH_CASCADE. Configuration therefore separates N_nash_subsurface, K_nash_subsurface, and nash_storage_subsurface from N_nash_surface, K_nash_surface, nash_storage_surface, nsubsteps_nash_surface, Kinf_nash_surface, and retention_depth_nash_surface. When diagnosing timing, identify the path first: direct surface, delayed lateral, or groundwater baseflow.

lessons.title: BMI Lifecycle and Configuration Contracts
lessons.summary: bmi_cfe.c owns allocation, configuration parsing, forcing selection, lifecycle methods, variable metadata, and scalar-grid exchange.

content.text: CFE exposes a C Bmi struct populated with function pointers. Initialize validates self and the configuration path, resets current_time_step, parses configuration, converts the fixed time-step size to hours, allocates output flux pointers, initializes their values, and selects the forcing source. forcing_file=BMI means precipitation and time arrive through set_value; any other value is treated as a local forcing-file path whose lines are counted and loaded.

Update chooses rainfall from the current local forcing record or the BMI-supplied precipitation value, converts precipitation mass per area to water depth where required, calls run_cfe, and advances current_time_step. Update_until repeatedly calls Update until the requested model time is reached and rejects incompatible target times. Finalize frees dynamically allocated arrays and state. Lifecycle tests should exercise failure as well as success, especially null inputs, bad files, repeated timing calls, and pointer state after finalization.

BMI variable methods map standardized names to C storage. Get_input_var_names and Get_output_var_names publish exchange contracts; Get_var_type, Get_var_units, Get_var_itemsize, and Get_var_nbytes describe representation. Get_value copies data, Get_value_ptr exposes model-owned storage, and Set_value writes inputs or parameters. Most CFE exchanges use grid 0, whose rank and size are one and whose type is scalar. Shape, spacing, coordinate, node, edge, and face methods return BMI_FAILURE because they do not apply to this scalar grid.

Configuration parsing is strict enough to be part of runtime behavior. The configuration reference identifies forcing mode, soil properties, reservoir parameters, partitioning and routing selections, initial fractions, optional root-zone fields, and freeze-thaw coupling. Defaults exist for selected optional fields, but required parameters and mutually dependent options must agree. An initialization failure should be traced to read_init_config_cfe and its validation branches before investigating timestep science.

lessons.title: Build, Test, Debug, and Contribute
lessons.summary: CMake options select CFE integration modes, CTest exercises BMI behavior, and mass-balance evidence anchors scientific debugging.

content.text: CFE requires GCC and CMake. The top-level CMake configuration expects one relevant mode such as BASE, FORCING, FORCINGPET, AETROOTZONE, NGEN, or UNITTEST. BASE and pseudo-framework modes build executables from different main programs and coupled sources. NGEN defines BMI_ACTIVE and builds the cfebmi shared library from bmi_cfe.c, cfe.c, giuh.c, conceptual_reservoir.c, and nash_cascade.c, linking the C math library and exposing bmi_cfe.h as a public header.

The documented standalone sequence initializes submodules, configures from a build directory with cmake ../ -DBASE=ON, builds, then runs ./run_cfe.sh BASE. Framework examples have different executable inputs and configuration-file ordering. For NGEN, realization library_file and init_config paths must match the actual build layout. A load failure from a wrong shared-library path occurs before CFE initialization and should not be diagnosed as a hydrologic failure.

Tests are registered through CMake and run with the test build target or ctest --test-dir build. combined_bmi_funcs_test exercises many methods in one routine. test_bmi_model dispatches focused lifecycle, metadata, value-access, timing, and grid-method tests using a reusable fixture. New test executables must be added with add_executable, linked to cfebmi, registered with add_test, and followed by CMake reconfiguration.

Scientific debugging should use conservation and component outputs. Compare cumulative precipitation against ET, channel outflow, leakage, and changes in soil, groundwater, GIUH queue, and Nash stores. Then isolate whether an error begins in forcing conversion, ET, partitioning, reservoir fluxes, routing, or final aggregation. The repository's contribution guide requires tests for new code and recommends following local style. Source and tests at the recorded commit are authoritative when a curriculum statement or assumption disagrees with behavior.

glossary.definition: A simplified conceptual model intended to reproduce important runoff-generation behavior of the National Water Model.
The lifecycle, timing, variable, value-access, and grid function contract exposed by CFE for framework coupling.
Rainfall depth not admitted to soil storage by the selected partitioning method and therefore sent to surface routing.
CFE rainfall partitioning based on soil moisture deficit, timestep, soil properties, and optional frozen-soil limitation.
An alternative variable-contributing-area partitioning method configured with inflection, shape, and urban-fraction parameters.
A water store with thresholded outlet coefficients and exponents used for soil and groundwater behavior.
Geomorphological instantaneous unit hydrograph; a weighted discrete travel-time distribution used to route surface runoff.
A series of conceptual linear reservoirs that delays surface or lateral flow while preserving routed storage.
Water actually removed to the atmosphere from rainfall, surface retention, or soil subject to demand and availability.
Accounting that reconciles cumulative water inputs with outputs, leakage, and changes in all model stores.
